About us: 
 Empowering our Clients with People-Driven Digital Innovation Across Europe
 We are a Group managing digital IT services and solutions, driven by people, innovation, agility, and deep industry insight. We are working with the largest private and public institutions to deliver IT services and solutions.
 Being an entrepreneurial digital services group with a Human-Sized Tech Company, we are built by passionate experts and led by seasoned leaders in IT and digital transformation.
 Role overview: 
 As a Performance Testing Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring that our applications meet the highest standards of performance, scalability, and reliability before being deployed to production.
 You will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, testers, architects, DevOps Engineers, and Infrastructure Teams to plan, design, execute, and evaluate performance tests under realistic business and technical conditions. Through your work, you will help identify potential bottlenecks, mitigate performance-related risks, enhance the end-user experience, and support the delivery of robust, high-quality software solutions across multiple business domains.
 Responsibilities: 
 Performance Test Planning: 
Participate in discovery and analysis workshops to understand business objectives, application requirements, and non-functional requirements (NFRs).
Identify and evaluate potential performance risks associated with new features, system enhancements, and architectural changes.
Define effective performance testing strategies aligned with business objectives, technical requirements, and system expectations.
Develop detailed Performance Test Plans and Assessment Documents, outlining testing scope, objectives, workload models, performance benchmarks, success criteria, and execution methodologies.
Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to validate assumptions, assess potential risks, and establish a clear understanding of expected system behavior under different workload conditions.
 Test design & script development: 
Develop robust, reusable, and maintainable performance test scripts in accordance with established engineering standards and best practices.
Design realistic workload models that reflect production usage patterns, translating business requirements into appropriate load profiles and testing scenarios.
Define and recommend suitable load testing approaches based on application architecture, usage patterns, and expected performance objectives.
Implement scripting techniques such as parameterization, correlation, dynamic test data management, and reusable components, leveraging existing frameworks or developing new solutions where required.
Support performance testing across multiple technology layers, including Web applications, Mobile platforms, APIs, and microservices architectures.
Maintain and continuously enhance performance test scripts, frameworks, and related documentation, ensuring consistency, reusability, and adherence to coding standards.
 Performance test execution: 
 • Design, configure, and execute various performance test types including: Load Testing , Stress Testing ,Spike Testing , Endurance (Soak) Testing , Scalability (Limit) Testing , Capacity Testing , Other test types (when applicable) 
 • Monitor execution progress, validate results, and ensure test integrity throughout the testing lifecycle.
 Performance Analysis: 
 Analyze test results to evaluate: response times , throughput , success rates , error rates , resource utilization ,scalability , system stability
 • Identify performance bottlenecks and correlate application behavior with infrastructure metrics (from used observability tools) to determine root causes and provide recommendations.
 Reporting & Recommendations 
 • Produce clear technical and executive performance testing reports (following pre existing templates or from scratch). 
 • Present findings to technical and non— technical stakeholders. 
 • Document risks, bottlenecks, trends, and improvement opportunities. 
 • Provide recommendations to improve application performance, scalability, and stability. 
 • Support development teams during performance optimization activities.
 Automation & Continuous Performance Testing 
 • Contribute to integrating performance testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 • Support automated performance test execution using enterprise tools and APIs.
 Required Technical Skills 
 Minimum 5 years of experience in software testing, with proven hands-on experience in performance testing. 
 Preferred: OpenText LoadRunner Enterprise , OpenText VuGen, OpenText Analysis
 Strong hands-on experience with at least one: Apache JMeter, Gatling, K6, NeoLoad / Blazemeter 
 Understanding of: performance testing methodologies, performance engineering principles, workload modelling, test planning, performance bottleneck identification, scalability concepts, capacity planning fundamentals, performance analysis techniques 
 Protocols & Technologies: HTTP / HTTPS , REST APIs , SOAP , GraphQL , WebSockets (nice to have) Understanding of: web applications , APIs , distributed systems, microservices architecture , mobile applications are considered as nice to have
 Scripting / programming: knowledge of one or more: JavaScript, Java ,Python , Groovy
 Exposure to monitoring platforms is a plus: Dynatrace / AppDynamics/ Icinga / Grafana / Datadog / Splunk /ELK Stack / Others
 DevOps & CI/CD: Git - mandatory; nice to have: GitLab CI /Jenkins/ Azure DevOps/ GitHub Actions 
 Language Skills 
 • Professional working proficiency in English 
 • French - min. B1-B2
